name: polymarket-edge-scanner
description: Read-only Polymarket market scanner with an explainable value engine and Workers AI analysis, deployable on Cloudflare's free tier.

scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:worker
scripts.dev: npm run build:dashboard && wrangler dev --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply pes-db --local --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.migrate:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply pes-db --remote --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy: npm run build:dashboard && wrangler deploy --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.deploy:dry: npm run build:dashboard && wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir .wrangler/dry-run --config apps/worker/wrangler.jsonc
